title: AI token and cents flow
description: Beta. Output tokens per second averaged over the selected range, grouped by caller team, billing tags, provider, and model. Health-check traffic is excluded. OpenRouter spend is router-reported USD converted to cents for the current UTC month at the range end; it is not an invoice.

panels.title: Total output
panels.description: Selected-range average; internal health checks excluded.

options.content: {{#if (or Value (eq Value 0))}}{{toFixed Value 2}} tok/s{{else}}No data{{/if}}Total output

panels.title: Local output share
panels.description: Share tagged local over the selected range. An empty local cohort is zero; no output leaves the share unknown.

options.content: {{#if (or Value (eq Value 0))}}{{toFixed Value 2}} %{{else}}No data{{/if}}Local output share

panels.title: OpenRouter month to date
panels.description: Current UTC month at the range end. Exact max-over-time counter subtraction; new series start at zero baseline. Counter resets can undercount spend.

options.content: {{#if (or Value (eq Value 0))}}{{toFixed Value 2}} cents{{else}}No data{{/if}}OpenRouter month to date

panels.title: Caller → billing class → provider → model
panels.description: Link width is increase(output tokens) / selected seconds, not an instantaneous rate. Missing or all-false billing tags are unclassified. Multiple true tags share one combined class so tokens are counted once. Caller means team; unavailable labels remain explicit.

targets.expr: sum by (team, api_provider, model, tag_telemetry_billing_class_free, tag_telemetry_billing_class_local, tag_telemetry_billing_class_paid, tag_telemetry_billing_class_subscription) (increase(litellm_output_tokens_metric_total{team!="litellm-internal-health-check"}[$__range])) / $__range_s

options.content: **Output tok/s:** selected-range average. **Caller:** router team. **Billing class:** telemetry tags; combined tags stay together, and missing or all-false tags are unclassified. **OpenRouter cents:** current UTC month at the range end, independent of the selected duration; counter resets can undercount. Missing data stays unknown.
